statement: Not a bounty -- Stage 0 of docs/cairn-integration-plan.md. Independently re-verify a claimed ECDLP discrete-log certificate already produced by crypto-autoresearcher's own harness (docs/claims-and-verification.md): given curve {p, a, b}, points P and Q on it, and a claimed scalar k, accept iff k*P = Q. reward is 0 because this objective funds nothing -- it exists only so harness/runner.py can call cairn's own sandboxed verifier as a second, independently implemented check on every witness this program claims, per Stage 0's own rule: a disagreement between the two is a hard failure, never advisory.

curve.description: Short Weierstrass y^2 = x^3 + a*x + b over F_p, p > 3.
